spec.title: Classifier agreement with NLCD 2021
spec.question: How far are stored classifier shares of water, impervious and pervious land from an independent 30 m national land-cover reference over the same frame?
spec.split: None: too few distinct frames for a calibration/holdout split. Descriptive only; nothing was tuned.
metrics: mean absolute error per aggregate class (pp)
whether the classified score lies inside the reference score interval
limitations: NLCD is a model-derived product with its own error, especially for fine urban pervious cover; this measures disagreement with a reference, not error against truth.
Epochs differ: NLCD 2021 versus scans in 2026.
Buildings and pavement are not separable in NLCD, so building/pavement confusion cannot be measured here.
Repeated classifications of one frame are averaged to one row per distinct frame so a single frame cannot dominate.
Rows labelled `probe` are excluded as manual test inserts (PREREGISTRATION.md, Addendum 1).

inputs.source: USGS National Land Cover Database 2021: land cover and percent developed imperviousness (CONUS)
Mannahatta public scan feed (Supabase `analyses`, public read policy)
